note: On the east shore of Candle Lake in two parts: a north loop behind the main beach and service centre, and south loops on a wooded point by the Minowukaw dam, where the sites closest to the water are the short ones. Sand dunes and a boardwalk along the beach. --Claude
summary: Keep. SKPP 290405 Minowukaw: 100 electric sites (85 nightly, 15 seasonal) in a north loop (M101-156) and south loops (M201-222, M301-324) ~900 m apart on one campground road; 15/30 A, 50 A on 19; max 50 ft (stored 32 was wrong), six nightly sites under 23 ft. Showers, washrooms, taps, sani dump. Season May 14-Sep 30 2026. Stored $35 fee block matches. Lakeview kept on the south point's shore row (M301/M302 nightly, 25/32 ft, ~20-35 m from the water behind a band of spruce/pine; all rows 'Near Water - no'). Phone '' -> 1-306-929-8400.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (stored, not --AWH). Every Minowukaw row 'Near Water - no'. The only sites near the shore are the south point's west row: M301 (53.76925,-105.16365, 25 ft) and M302 (53.76905,-105.16393, 32 ft), both nightly, ~20-35 m from Candle Lake behind a continuous tree band (Esri z17; site photos show forest with light through the trunks) - a view, not lakefront. M303/M305/M307/M309 are as close but 14-16 ft (too short for a 23-ft rig). The north loop (M101-M156) sits ~150-250 m back from the beach.
WEBSITE: stored pair (Tourism SK candle-lake page + SKPP parkId 290405) both live; keep.

PIN: stored 53.7780,-105.1560 sits on the north loop (M101-M156 centroid ~53.7772,-105.1570): keep. The south loops centre ~53.7695,-105.1625 (~0.95 km SSW); the centroid of all 100 sites is 53.7737,-105.1593 (~490 m) - not a better pin, it falls between the loops in forest.

NOT A SPLIT: the north and south loops are ~0.95 km apart but share one campground road and the agency maps them as one 'Minowukaw Campground (North/South)' with the south loops' exit through the north camping area.
